relations: Camera panning leftward causes the entire garden scene to slide steadily to the right.
Scene sliding right shifts the upper-left green lens flare rightward and slightly downward.
Continued rightward drift brings a brighter green flare orb into view at the lower-right.
Foreground shrubs and background foliage shift together, preserving plant identities without growth or falling.
caption: The video captures a sunlit garden border under strong backlight, with a large dark reddish-purple tree filling the left background, a bright yellow-green tree on the right, and a rounded clipped hedge sitting mid-right. A foreground row of reddish-brown leafy shrubs mixed with pale green plants stands above a strip of grass. A prominent green lens flare hovers in the upper-left. The whole scene slides steadily to the right as the camera pans leftward, revealing a magenta flower bed at left edge. As the pan continues, the upper-left flare moves rightward and slightly downward, while a brighter green flare orb grows into view at the lower-right. The rounded hedge and yellow-green tree drift toward and partly off the right edge. Foreground shrubs and background foliage shift together, so no individual plant is seen to grow, fall, or be struck. Any leaf-level sway remains too subtle to confirm. The purple bed stays visible at the left, and the rounded hedge remains near the right, leaving the lateral motion still ongoing rather than completed throughout.
